title: Yummy Earthy Italian Rice Noodles Frittata
description: A one-pot Italian frittata featuring rice stick noodles, earthy vegetables, and a nut-free blend of cheeses.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant for 30 seconds.
Add diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Add rice noodles and stir to coat with oil and tomato, cooking for 3 minutes.
Whisk eggs, ricotta, and parmesan together in a bowl.
Pour the egg mixture over the noodles and vegetables in the skillet, spreading evenly.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let cook for 8 minutes until the edges set.
Remove the lid, sprinkle salt and pepper, and cook for an additional 4 minutes until the top is set and lightly browned.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve warm.
